name: tasks-md
description: A spec and tooling for TASKS.md — the AI-native task queue format
author: Fyodor Ivanischev

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/parser && npm run build -w packages/conformance && npm run build -w packages/lint -w packages/mcp -w packages/cli
scripts.lint: node packages/lint/dist/cli.js TASKS.md && node scripts/check-docs-backend-drift.mjs && npm run lint:volatile-counts
scripts.lint:volatile-counts: node scripts/check-volatile-counts.mjs --self-test && node --test scripts/check-volatile-counts.test.mjs && node scripts/check-volatile-counts.mjs
